I wrote `component.html` in the sales folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so I haven't checked how it looks.

It has your content exactly as given: the "Pipeline" heading, the "New Deal" button, the "Search deals" field, and the five-row table with its five columns. It's all inside `#component` at 1280px wide, in static HTML and CSS with no JavaScript.

I followed `DESIGN.md`, which limited how far I could push "make it pop". The page is white, with one column and a 1120px maximum width. The title is large Unbounded Light in capitals. "New Deal" is the single ink-filled pill, and the table sits in a card with a soft shadow. The stages are blue pills, deal values are bold, and company names are semibold. That is bold within the brand rules, not loud. The design file doesn't allow extra colours, blue buttons or new elements, and you asked for exactly this content, so I added nothing.

- **Tokens:** `tokens.css` is a separate file and the page has to be self-contained, so I copied only the tokens the page uses into the `<style>` block. No raw hex values appear in the component styles.
- **Fonts:** the folder has no font files, so Unbounded and Archivo fall back to system fonts unless the viewer already has them installed.
- **Won stage:** the design file allows only one pill style, so "Won" looks the same as the other stages.
